event.task: Call records arriving dirty from the switch feed (un-normalized numbers, missing duration or direction) are being dropped by ingest. Add call-record repair so salvageable records are cleaned and stored instead of dropped.

plan.summary: Implemented repairCallRecord() in repair.ts: it normalizes both phone numbers to E.164, backfills durationMs from the timestamps, and defaults a missing direction to inbound. Added unit tests in repair.test.ts proving it produces records that pass strict validation. Call-record repair is done.
